properties.description: U-Net with an ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B4 encoder for building INSTANCE segmentation from very high resolution RGB aerial imagery. Emits three channels - mask, per-instance normalised distance transform, and instance boundary - which are resolved into separate building footprints by marker-controlled watershed. Trained on 18,557 chips filtered from hotosm/vhr-building-segmentation by a label-quality classifier, after manual review established that 27.2% of that dataset's labels are unusable (n = 6,459 reviewed).
properties.mlm:name: unet-effb4-buildings

classification:classes.name: distance
classification:classes.description: per-instance normalised distance transform; seeds the watershed

classification:classes.name: boundary
classification:classes.description: band at walls shared by two instances
